thought: Dusk on Throop Ave, sky deep blue with pink clouds, lamps coming on. A white SUV is parked about five metres to my left. I'll turn to it and walk up to the door.
I'm in the SUV. The radio shows BK House with no sets, and the console is complaining about a blocked fetch. I'll pull out and roll up the avenue.
Doing about 24 km/h with a car five metres ahead. I'll hold the throttle and see whether the traffic moves. If it doesn't I'll go round it.
